title: Generate CALPHAD liquidus and partition coefficient data
action: Using PyCalphad and the Fe-C-Si database, compute stable equilibrium phase diagrams for Fe-C-Si with Si = 0, 2, 3, 4.5 wt% and for each alloying addition (Cu up to 1 wt%, Mn up to 0.5 wt%, Cr up to 0.25 wt%, P up to 0.25 wt%). For each composition record the austenite and graphite liquidus temperatures, eutectic points, and partition coefficients of all elements. Cover the carbon range stated in the paper (e.g., 2.5–4.5 wt% C, varying with Si).
description: Required intermediate: generates the numerical data points that the subsequent polynomial fitting steps depend on. Without this step, the coefficients cannot be correctly derived.

title: Fit polynomial coefficients for ternary Fe-C-Si liquidus
action: From the generated liquidus data for the ternary system, fit linear relations T_L = T0 + m_C * w_C for each Si content. Then fit second-order polynomials to the obtained T0^γ, m_C^γ, T0^gra, m_C^gra as functions of w_Si (the polynomial coefficients correspond to the paper's Eqns. 3–6). Output the polynomial coefficients as a JSON object.
description: Scored artifact: polynomial coefficients for the ternary Fe-C-Si system, representing the austenite and graphite liquidus intercepts and slopes as second-order polynomials of silicon content.
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'T0_gamma', 'mC_gamma', 'T0_gra', 'mC_gra'; each value is a list of three numeric coefficients [a0, a1, a2] for the polynomial in w_Si.

title: Fit extended polynomial coefficients with Cu, Mn, Cr, P additions
action: Using the liquidus data including Cu, Mn, Cr, P additions, fit the corrected expressions for T0^γ (including additive shifts and Cu-Si interaction), m_C^γ (including Cu-Si dependent correction), and T0^gra (additive shifts for Cu, Mn, Cr, P). Output the polynomial coefficients for the alloy system.
description: Scored artifact: polynomial coefficients for the quinary system with Cu, Mn, Cr, P as expressed in the paper's extended liquidus description.
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'T0_gamma_alloy', 'mC_gamma_alloy', 'T0_gra_alloy'. T0_gamma_alloy must contain the keys: 'const', 'Si', 'Si2', 'Cu', 'Cu_Si', 'Cu_Si2', 'Mn', 'Mn_Si', 'Cr', 'P' (all numbers). mC_gamma_alloy must contain: 'const', 'Si', 'Si2', 'Cu', 'Cu_Si', 'Cu_Si2'. T0_gra_alloy must contain: 'const', 'Si', 'Si2', 'Cu', 'Mn', 'Cr', 'P'.

title: Derive eutectic carbon content rational expression
action: Equate the fitted austenite and graphite liquidus expressions (from the alloy system) to obtain the rational expression for the eutectic carbon content w_C^eut as a function of w_Si and alloy additions. Output the coefficients of this rational expression.
description: Scored artifact: coefficients for the full rational expression for eutectic carbon content (the paper's Eqn. 20 analogue).
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'numerator_coefficients' (array of 10 numbers in order: constant, w_Si, w_Si^2, w_Cu, w_Si·w_Cu, w_Si^2·w_Cu, w_Mn, w_Si·w_Mn, w_Cr, w_P) and 'denominator_coefficients' (array of 6 numbers in order: constant, w_Si, w_Si^2, w_Cu, w_Si·w_Cu, w_Si^2·w_Cu).

title: Derive approximate quadratic eutectic and carbon equivalent expressions
action: By fitting the eutectic valley calculated from the full model, derive the simplified quadratic approximation for w_C^eut and the corresponding carbon equivalent CE. Output the coefficients.
description: Scored artifact: coefficients for the approximate quadratic eutectic composition and carbon equivalent formulas.
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'wC_eut_approx' (array of 6 numbers: [constant, w_Si coefficient, w_Si^2 coefficient, w_Cu coefficient, w_Cr coefficient, w_P coefficient]) and 'CE_approx' (array of 5 numbers: [w_Si coefficient, w_Si^2 coefficient, w_Cu coefficient, w_Cr coefficient, w_P coefficient]).

title: Fit partition coefficient polynomials for C, Si, Cu, Mn, Cr, P
action: From the partition coefficient data generated in the first step, fit the polynomials for k_C, k_Si as functions of w_Si and ΔT, and for k_Cu, k_Mn, k_Cr, k_P as functions of w_Si, ΔT, and (for Cr) ignoring Si dependence. Output the polynomial coefficients.
description: Scored artifact: polynomial coefficients for the partition coefficients of all elements, as used in the paper's microsegregation description.
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'k_C','k_Si','k_Cu','k_Mn','k_Cr','k_P'. k_C must contain: 'const','Si','dT','Si_dT','dT2'. k_Si must contain: 'const','Si','dT','Si_dT'. k_Cu must contain: 'const','Si','dT','Si_dT'. k_Mn must contain: 'const','Si','dT','Si2_dT'. k_Cr must contain: 'const','dT'. k_P must contain: 'const','dT'. All values are numbers.
